}}'''Igaine Luin''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]] who served as the [[Amyrlin Seat]] from {{Ne|476}} to {{Ne|520}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Igaine Luin}}

==History==
Igaine held the position for forty-four years until her death in {{Ne|520}}. She was [[Cerilla Marodred]]'s successor and [[Beryl Marle]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Igaine was an Amyrlin of average strength and influence. She was chosen in large part because she would lead the [[White Tower]] away from the open involvement in the world's affairs that her four predecessor had espoused.

Around [[500 NE]], during Igaine's reign, the last traces of the nation of [[Caralain]] vanished.
